verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique, attorney-led immigration law firm offering visa and green-card legal services, not a software product, so running it headlessly or in CI is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any automatable software interface; the probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
